<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 138.76, 131.45 (two peaks), 130.59 (two peaks), and 121.30 ppm fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110‑150 ppm). Counting each carbon represented by these peaks gives 1 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
